targets.title: Top-down restoration of speech in cochlear-implant users
targets.evidence_quote: Following the failure to measure perceptual restoration benefits in CI users in Studies 1 and 2 using the interrupted sentences paradigm, a “close” replication ( LeBel et al. , 2017 ) of the original study conducted by Bhargava et al. (2014) was attempted.
targets.outcome_quote: A separate experiment, which aimed to provide a close replication of previous work on perceptual restoration in CI users, also found no consistent evidence of perceptual restoration, contrasting the original study's previously reported findings.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The close replication explicitly failed to detect the original restoration benefit. Improvements in other listening conditions are not presented as replication success. Earlier Jaekel work is a comparison/background rather than the stated target.
